Abbott Laboratories has agreed to pay nearly $385 million to resolve a federal investigation and lawsuit, as well as lawsuits filed by states, related to allegations over the safety of its powdered infant formulas.

Abbott, based in the north suburbs, recalled the formulas in 2022 after reports of illnesses and deaths among babies who had consumed them, due to Cronobacter sakazakii and Salmonella Newport infections. It was a recall that contributed to parents across the country struggling to find formula for their infants for a time.
